시편 83:1.content: A Song or Psalm of Asaph. Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.

시편 83:2.content: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.

시편 83:3.content: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.

시편 83:4.content: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.

시편 83:5.content: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee:

시편 83:6.content: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;

시편 83:7.content: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;

시편 83:8.content: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.

시편 83:9.content: Do unto them as unto the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:

시편 83:10.content: Which perished at En–dor: they became as dung for the earth.

시편 83:11.content: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:

시편 83:12.content: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.

시편 83:13.content: O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.

시편 83:14.content: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;

시편 83:15.content: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.

시편 83:16.content: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O Lord.

시편 83:17.content: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:

시편 83:18.content: That men may know that thou, whose name alone is Jehovah, art the most high over all the earth.
